title: Attendance management system
description: Full Stack attendance management application with REST API and JWT authentication, currently in development.

metrics.label: modules: students, groups, teachers, attendance, schedules

features: Students, groups, teachers and attendance management

caseStudy.context: Personal project: design an end-to-end modern full stack attendance application — from database schema to interface — to deepen my FastAPI / React practice and ship a reusable tool.
caseStudy.role: Full Stack design and development: FastAPI REST API, JWT authentication, React 19 + TypeScript interface, MySQL database.
constraints: Real full stack architecture: documented REST API, secure JWT auth
Modern stack to master in depth: FastAPI, React 19, TypeScript
5 business modules: students, groups, teachers, attendance, schedules
Built alongside studies → time management and controlled scope
approach: MySQL modeling of the 5 modules, then a FastAPI REST API with auto-generated docs
JWT authentication with role management on the API side
Strictly typed React 19 + TypeScript interface, components per business module
Iterative delivery: one module shipped and tested at a time
caseStudy.outcome: Application being finalized: documented REST API with JWT, typed React 19 interface, 5 functional modules. My reference project for modern full stack practice.
